ops.title: cc-transcript Word/payload/quote primitives (Phase A of rm-guard plan) built + reviewed, shipping as v14.6.0; consumer semantics captain-hook Phase B depends on

ops.body:
Phase A of the cross-repo rm-guard plan SHIPPED in cc-transcript (2026-07-19, review clean, two fixes applied; released as **v14.6.0**, main commit a83aaf4, PyPI via tag workflow). Core: `rust/crates/core/src/command.rs` — `Word {raw, value, span, expandable}` (+hidden `layer`, `content_offset`), `Command.words` parallel to args, `nesting`/`host_delta`/`contexts` replace the old `substitution: bool`, `payload_parts` enumerates `bash|sh|zsh|ash|dash|ksh -c` + `eval` payloads as first-class nested parts, `shell_quote`/`embeddable`/`quote_for`, `SpliceError::NotEmbeddable`.

Consumer semantics Phase B (captain-hook) must honor:
- `Occurrence.nesting` (0 = top), `.host`, `.quote_contexts` (outermost-first, `"'"`/`'"'`/`""`), `.embeddable(text)`, `.quote_for(text)`; `CommandLine.quote()`; `PAYLOAD_DEPTH_LIMIT == 3` (beyond cap: NOT enumerated — fall-open).
- Tainted payloads (`bash -c "$CMD"`, `eval "$(...)"`) emit NO parts; fish/csh/tcsh enumerate span-less; escaped/non-verbatim payloads span-less; `-c` must sit in the LEADING option run (operand or `--` ends it; `-o`/`-O` clusters consume their argument — `bash -euo pipefail -c` still enumerates, `bash script.sh -c 'rm'` does not).
- Bare-layer embeddability is strict (shlex-safe only, non-empty): multi-word rewrites into bare `-c`/eval payloads refuse → consumer forfeits to block. Single layer forbids only `'`; double forbids unescaped `\ " $ `` `.
- BEHAVIOR CHANGE: `command_prefixes`/`prefixes()` now include payload commands (`bash -c 'git push'` → `("bash", "git push")`), mirroring substitutions since 14.1.
- `primary()`/`head()` filter `nesting == 0`; splice rejects host+nested simultaneous rewrite (Overlap) and non-embeddable payload replacements (ValueError "does not survive its enclosing quote layers").

Related: [[rm-trash-rewrite-shipped]] [[rm-guard-shipped]] [[shared-tree-build-lock-races]]
